extracted.intended_audience: conference organizers / program committee chairs using OpenReview (PC members, area chair managers)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for performing manual reviewer and area-chair assignments in an OpenReview venue, including required setup steps and the UI locations to complete assignments. Focuses on the manual-assignment workflow (as opposed to automatic matching).

rubrics_metrics.name: Run Paper Matching Setup
rubrics_metrics.description: Run the Paper Matching Setup from the venue request form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Paper Matching Setup must be run to enable manual assignments. You can choose whether or not to calculate conflict of interest or affinity scores during this setup, but the setup itself is required even for manual assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decide whether to calculate conflicts and affinity scores
rubrics_metrics.description: You can choose whether or not to calculate conflict of interest or affinity scores when running Paper Matching Setup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculating conflicts/affinity is optional for manual assignments, but the choice is made as part of the Paper Matching Setup process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assignment Configuration must be created
rubrics_metrics.description: Paper Matching Setup creates the Assignment Configuration that enables manual assignments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Without this Assignment Configuration (created by the Paper Matching Setup) you will not be able to make manual assignments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access Edge Browser from PC console Timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Return to the PC console, in the "Timeline" section you can access the link to the Edge Browser to make manual assignments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Timeline link in the PC console to open the Edge Browser interface where assignments are performed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the 'Assign' button to assign reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the 'Assign' button to assign a reviewer to a paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When you assign a reviewer using the Assign button, reviewers will be notified upon assignment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invite Assignment button unavailable for manual assignments
rubrics_metrics.description: The "Invite Assignment" button is not currently available for manual assignments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not expect an "Invite Assignment" workflow option when doing manual assignments; use the Assign button in the Edge Browser instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assigning Area Chairs follows same setup
rubrics_metrics.description: For Area Chairs, run the Paper Matching Setup and select "area chairs" from the list of roles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After selecting area chairs in the Paper Matching Setup, return to the PC console to access the assignment link for Area Chairs in the Edge Browser (same Edge Browser workflow as for reviewers).

rubrics_metrics.name: New venue UI has different workflow location
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are using the new venue UI, refer to the assignments section of the workflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users of the new venue UI should consult the venue workflow's assignments section rather than this legacy/manual guide.
